exposure: HEI-2015 components (seafood/plant proteins, total protein foods, greens/beans, saturated fats, added sugars, refined grains, dairy)
AHEI-2010 components (nuts/legumes, sugar-sweetened beverages (SSBs)/fruit juice, sodium, DHA/EPA)
cohort: Pregnant women who completed a 3-month food-frequency questionnaire at median 13 weeks gestation.
finding: Higher adherence to healthy eating indices (HEI-2015 and AHEI-2010) and specific dietary components were associated with longer gestational length, with mixture models providing more robust associations and identifying unique contributors.
mod_finding: Associations between diet index mixtures and gestational length were less precise but consistent in women with spontaneous labors.
gest_age: Median 13 weeks gestation (for FFQ completion) and gestational length (as an outcome).
